# D10.T04 / First-run exact-release evidence binding

**Task ID:** D10.T04 / D10.G04, issue #736; source-review PR [#822](https://github.com/rumman52/Shuddho/pull/822).

**Observed defect:** The Day 10 decision accepted any plausible, historical `day9_first_run.source_revision` and `rollout_manifest_sha256` even when different from the exact authorized rollout. A malformed or modified human scorecard could be represented as a nonempty object, while a separately checked holdout receipt was left unrelated.

**Inputs:** `day9_first_run` is the full first-run report generated by `ruke_pilot_eval.evaluate` with a nonempty `run_id`, `run_kind=first_run`, `manifest_sha256`, `source_revision`, `rollout_manifest_sha256`, and `scores`. `holdout` is the independently held `day10_holdout` receipt for the *same* 40 attempts and manifest. C/D authenticate both files separately.

**Contract:** Require identical release ID, exact source SHA, rollout SHA-256, candidate-manifest SHA-256 between original report and holdout, and 40 distinct one-to-one case IDs. Preserve all original reviewer rubrics/totals, acceptance, deterministic/security and source-supported flags; reject edited or reindexed case outputs. Recompute accepted/total/by-cell from per-case accepted booleans and compare to the report. Existing holdout security and 36/40, 9/10 per-cell gates are not relaxed. A historical pre-fix first run may be retained but must not authorize an unrelated current release.

**Test evidence:** RED [#44755986612](https://github.com/rumman52/Shuddho/actions/runs/44755986612) on test-only `1607724cc9fe71699b9d116dec393a1d2c15dcd1`: 20 intended failures among 2,615 test cases executed with 102 skips. Exact final head green full suite, PostgreSQL18/browser/frontend/Coworker and governance must be checked separately.

**Scope:** Only the Day 10 evidence predicate, synthetic regression fixtures, this contract, plan and progress ledger. No API, migration, flag, provider, privately custodied data, real human signoff, rollout, telemetry or production traffic. The CLI proves internal consistency only, never itself authenticates operator-supplied evidence.

**Owner follow-up:** Obtain exact SHA independent review and strict native CI enforcement. Human D binds protected corpus and original blind reviews. C produces separately authenticated 20 operated receipts and approved staging identity. Founder and C sign exact eligible rollout separately. NO-GO until then.
